contract: Native parse-only ParseError remains parser_rejection; exact base CompileError thrown by php_spec_parse_eval becomes parser_static_rejection. Both rejected variants retain exact pending id/mode/profile/original bytes, canonical base64 message, positive source line and no AST. Other native Throwable and parser disagreement remain helper_unsupported.
full_file_syntax: The older 30,980-file classified report in dynamic-eval-native-diagnostics-review.json belongs to frozen native-bridge commit 90f913f09. This extension requires the separately reviewed merged frontend full gate; no full-gate result is claimed here.
transport_limit: check_source_service validates one pending/response shape and identity. It cannot authenticate a type-correct edited AST against source bytes or remember consumed request IDs; the trusted worker and later stateful runtime must preserve those guarantees.
evidence_recovery: Ignored focused, wire and targeted reports are under .tools/eval-native-diagnostics/.tools/eval-native-gates; run the listed commands in the private extension tree with its isolated adapter build.
